evidence_class: DERIVED (B182 deep checkpoint batch records, decoder-typed, block ids verified)
grade_rule: 'exact-under-window-dedup': the count is the B182 run's distinct TXIDs under its 200,000-tx dedup window; it becomes exact after the exact-dedup recount (B182 report --exact, S2)

input.file: $FORENSICS_R29_DEEP/checkpoint.log (the R29 B182 deep stage, outside git, read-only; a label, not a path)

moves_when: the exact-dedup recount (S2) replaces the window dedup; an S7 replay of 0..143,999 decides the re-applied grants
pending: whether the second listings below 144,000 re-applied the 200-atomic grant (pre-HF3 blockchain.go:995 executes every listed tx) needs a replay (S7); the figure is the distinct-registration count only
